description:
Read a file.
- Text files return file content (up to 2000 lines by default), each line prefixed with its 1-based physical line number in cat -n format (number, tab, content). The number prefix and tab are display metadata and must be removed from edit oldString/newString
- Use offset and limit to page through large files; line numbers stay absolute
- Set outline=true for C# (.cs) or Markdown (.md) to return a full-file structural outline with line locations instead of original file content; offset and limit are ignored, knowledge Markdown also injects its L1 summary when available, and unsupported file types return an error
- Knowledge Markdown uses the same physical lines as every other file, including frontmatter and blank lines
- Registered knowledge paths outside the workspace are readable when returned by knowledge_query
- PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images return an image attachment; offset and limit are ignored for images
- This tool only reads files; use list for directories

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to read

offset.description: Line number to start reading from for text files (1-indexed); ignored for images

limit.description: Max number of lines to read for text files (default 2000); ignored for images

outline.description: Return an outline instead of original content; supported only for C# (.cs) and Markdown (.md)
